title: FHFA House Price Index — monthly index for August 2027, 9:00 a.m. ET (one hour before the October 2027 Consumer Confidence print)
source: EST: fhfa.gov/data/hpi, fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) and parsed in full rather than inherited from the sibling ledgers that cite the same page. Its "2027 HPI Release Dates" table has three columns -- Date, Release Type, Last Included Data -- and its tenth row reads verbatim "Tuesday, October 26 | Monthly Index | August 2027". THE RELEASE TYPE MATTERS AND IS QUOTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: this is the MONTHLY index, not the quarterly edition, because the same table marks only four 2027 rows "Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables)" -- February 23, May 25, August 31 and November 30 -- and October is not one of them. All twelve rows of the table were checked against this chain's rule-derived last Tuesdays and all twelve match: Jan 26, Feb 23, Mar 30, Apr 27, May 25, Jun 29, Jul 27, Aug 31, Sep 28, Oct 26, Nov 30, Dec 28. The 9:00 a.m. ET time is FHFA's standing convention for this release and is NOT stated on this page, so it is the weakest claim in this file. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract, and because this calendar's confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for a federal statistical agency's own posted forward calendar; the page itself is a primary source and a published 2027 schedule, which is stronger than the estimate label suggests. Promote when this calendar gains such a prefix, or on the FHFA news release for the September 2027 edition naming its successor. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), the same morning as the Consumer Confidence print and one hour ahead of it. It is proposed for the reason the 09-28 sibling proposed its own FHFA leg: this is the only same-morning company the October CB print has, and a session reading the 10:00 tape needs to know a housing print landed at 9:00. THREE THINGS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) IT IS THE CALENDAR ARITHMETIC'S INDEPENDENT WITNESS, NOT A WITNESS ABOUT THE CONFERENCE BOARD. FHFA publishing on 2027-10-26 is evidence that 2027-10-26 is a last Tuesday; it says nothing whatever about the Conference Board's intentions, and the CB ledger is careful not to let it. Both publishers happen to key off the same weekday rule, which is why the two calendars agree twelve times out of twelve. (2) THE OCTOBER EDITION IS MONTHLY, COVERING AUGUST 2027 DATA -- a roughly two-month reporting lag, so it carries no information about the October survey panel the CB print reports on. The two releases share a morning and nothing else. (3) THE CB LANE MEASURED NOTHING ON THIS DATE AT INTRADAY RESOLUTION. Its whole study is at daily-bar resolution and says nothing about the 9:00-to-10:30 ET window, which is the only place a same-morning interaction between these two releases could live. A lane taking this id inherits an open question, not a finding. Same channel caveat as every macro entry: symbols is empty and no house playbook is housing- or macro-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
